hero.title: How to Play
hero.subtitle: Three minutes to learn. A lifetime of bragging rights. Master the mental battlefield of binary deduction and cipher breaking.

advancedAlert.title: Advanced Elimination Logic Activated
advancedAlert.body: Showing conditional probability trees, permutation math, and strict turn-burn reduction matrices throughout this breakdown.

secret.title: The Secret Number
secret.intro: Each duelist locks in an undisclosed 4-digit code. Every code must adhere to strict mathematical validity constraints:
secret.footer: 4 unique digits kept strictly hidden inside an encrypted vault.

guess.title: The Guess Protocol
guess.intro: Every round, transmit 4 non-repeating digits. You receive instantaneous positional telemetry.
guess.footer: Repeat guesses are prohibited by UI. Every probe burns one turn token.

firstMove.title: Who Moves First?
firstMove.body: System flips an algorithmic 50/50 token. First mover gets initiative; second mover gets retrospective balance.

matrix.title: The Deduction Matrix
matrix.intro: Clues are calculated in real-time after every submitted attempt. Memorize these three tactical signatures:

pico.description: Correct digit locked in the exact right position.
pico.advBody: Digit & Slot verified. Do not shift slot.

pala.description: Digit exists inside the vault, but is currently in the wrong slot.
pala.advBody: Keep digit; rotate across remaining 3 slots.

miss.label: MISS
miss.description: Digit is totally absent from the secret number. Completely eliminated.

example.title: A Turn, Dissected

step.one: Right digit & right slot. Target anchored.
step.two: 1 exists in vault (Slot 3), but transmitted into Slot 2.
step.three: 5 is completely unassigned in 3719. Discard it.
step.four: Identical position and value lock. Second Pico.

example.note: Note: The clue does NOT specify which digit caused which signal!

directive.title: Master Deduction Directive
directive.body: If your initial guess yields <yellow>1 Pico</yellow> and <pink>2 Palas</pink>, you already possess 3 out of 4 correct vault numbers (75% precision). <white>Never randomize on Turn 2.</white> Keep 3 numbers, permute positions, and swap only the single suspect candidate.

sudden.title: The 12-Turn Sudden Death Protocol
sudden.body: If neither duelist decrypts all 4 digits within 12 attempts, the duel terminates in a <white>Tactical Draw</white>. Both secret vaults are unveiled simultaneously for mutual review.

cta.title: Ready to test your deduction?
cta.body: Jump straight into an offline AI duel or invite a rival in seconds. No download required.

advancedExample.intro: Opponent secret: 3719 (hidden from you). Deduce using only the clues.

deduction.1: 3 hits in total: 3, 1 and 9 are in the secret. The 5 misses, discard it.
deduction.2: Only slot 3 changed (5 for 7). Fixes stay at 2 and one more Pala appears: 7 is in the secret, but not in slot 3. The digits are 3, 1, 7 and 9.
deduction.3: From turn 1, the 1 is not in slot 2. Since the 7 is not in slot 3, the 7 goes in slot 2 and the 1 in slot 3. Result: 4 Fixes.

advancedExample.note: Every clue rules out combinations: compare two guesses that differ in a single slot.
